name: TC-AN-QB-015 — 端到端：批量填写→复制 连续操作 [P1]
description: 审核节点编辑页已打开，通过批量填写造数据后验证复制功能
module: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row'); if (rows.length > 0) { const editBtn = rows[0].querySelector('a[href*=edit], button'); if (editBtn) { editBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false }; })()

steps.description: 记录初始参与人数(存量)

steps.text: ═══ Phase 1: 批量填写(造测试数据) ═══

steps.expression: (() => { const batchBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim() === '批量填写'); if (batchBtn) { batchBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal'); if (!modal) return { found: false }; const textarea = modal.querySelector('textarea'); const newPeople = JSON.stringify([{empId:'421225',empName:'宗育'},{empId:'320729',empName:'澜蓝'},{empId:'335890',empName:'宇天'}]); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(textarea, newPeople); textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return { found: true, inputCount: 3 }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal'); const confirmBtn = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim() === '确认导入'); if (confirmBtn) { confirmBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const c = document.querySelector('[class*=selectedLabel]'); const toasts = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-message-notice')).map(t => t.textContent.trim()); return { afterFillCount: c ? c.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-selection-item').length : -1, toasts }; })()
steps.description: Phase1: 验证批量填写结果

steps.text: ═══ Phase 2: 复制(验证已有参与人含测试数据) ═══

steps.expression: (() => { const copyBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim() === '复制'); if (copyBtn) { copyBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const toasts = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-message-notice')).map(t => t.textContent.trim()); const hasCopyToast = toasts.some(t => t.includes('已复制')); return { toastTexts: toasts, hasCopyToast }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: 审核节点编辑页已打开（不触碰存量数据）
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 批量填写3位测试参与人
2. 验证导入成功
3. 复制已选参与人
4. 验证复制toast
_testDesign.expectedResult: 1. 批量填写后参与人数增加（含存量+3位测试数据）\n2. 复制后toast'已复制 N 位参与人'\n3. 不执行清空操作，存量数据安全
_testDesign.groupPath: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮
